notes.title: Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord – Demo Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120390/c5926e7db592f0cefbc0f0368b110459ff7dbf9d.jpg
Greetings to all tactical RPG fans!

We are thrilled to announce that the demo version of Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord is officially live. And tomorrow, we will take part in the Steam Next Fest June 2025!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172900/Stones_Keeper_II_Chaos_Lord_Demo/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120390/6527e6c4cd32aed29d57debcbbf95813ae664897.gif

What to expect in the demo:

 About 30 minutes of gameplay—experience the new campaign from the perspective of the undead army’s lord.
 Evaluate innovations and balance changes—we've considered feedback from the original game and reworked numerous aspects.
 New tactical systems—Zone of Control, rear attacks, and more.
 Complete visual overhaul—updated animations for all units, interfaces, dialogue portraits, fortress scenes, and merchants.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120390/b64a8f235370c3b1bfdf3c8e28f20e8bc070e00b.gif

Thank you for your support and participation! This is a crucial stage for us—your feedback during the demo phase helps us refine the final release.

Stay tuned for announcements, streams, and future updates.
